VBO:0201388.summary: Quick to announce unfamiliar sounds and affectionate with their people, Villanucos were described by Mariano Gómez Fernández as farm companions in Bizkaia’s Encartaciones district. His account records rodent and small-game hunting, and dogs that accompanied the larger Villano before cattle were caught.
VBO:0201388.shortDescription: Mariano Gómez Fernández described an affectionate Encartaciones farm companion, quick to alert and historically used for ratting.
